goal.text: The user is making two slices of peanut-butter toast and wants to keep track of what they have already set out, which utensil they are on, and whether both slices are finished.

turns.text: What did I set down before I opened this drawer?

trigger.detail: user asks for a status recap while reaching into the drawer

expected_answer.text: The peanut butter jar. You carried it over from the island and set it down right before opening the drawer.

turns.text: Did the towel go on the plate, or under it?

trigger.detail: user cuts back to the earlier setup step

expected_answer.text: On top. You put the plate down first, then unfolded the sheet over it and patted it flat.

turns.text: Oh, before I forget — back when I was ripping that sheet, was a plant in view?

trigger.detail: user pulls a stale detail out of memory mid-answer

expected_answer.text: Yes. A potted plant was visible just past the island for about a second while you tore the towel.

turns.text: I swapped blades — did I keep the first?

trigger.detail: drawer closed and the second utensil carried away

expected_answer.text: No. You lifted one out, set it back in, and took a different one before shutting the drawer.

turns.text: Mm-hm, mm — actually, what did I do with it at the sink?

trigger.detail: backchannel turns into a question as the sink step ends

expected_answer.text: You rinsed it under the running tap, holding it in your left hand while your right worked the faucet.

turns.text: Did the slices land on that sheet, or bare counter?

trigger.detail: both slices out of the toaster and set down

expected_answer.text: On it. Both slices came out of the toaster and went straight onto the paper towel you laid down.

turns.text: Wait — did I bring that jar back over with me?

trigger.detail: return trip from the island completes

expected_answer.text: You did. You picked it up off the island on the way past and opened it as you walked back.

turns.text: and the lid, where'd that end up?

trigger.detail: user cuts in on the running answer

expected_answer.text: On the counter. You set it down with your left hand just before switching the jar over to that hand.

turns.text: Which hand has been doing the spreading?

trigger.detail: a long uninterrupted stretch of spreading

expected_answer.text: Your right. The knife has stayed in your right hand since the sink, with your left holding the bread steady.

turns.text: Um, hang on — that's not the one I rinsed, is it?

trigger.detail: user doubts their own recollection and cuts in

expected_answer.text: It is. Only one knife has come out of that drawer since the rinse, and it is still in your hand.

turns.text: Have I done both now, or just the one?

trigger.detail: first slice set down, second slice taken up

expected_answer.text: Just the one so far. You set that slice down on the towel and picked up the second, which you are spreading now.

turns.text: and have I looked up at all since I started this?

trigger.detail: user cuts in over the running answer

expected_answer.text: Not really. Your gaze has stayed on the counter in front of you the entire time you have been spreading.

turns.text: There — both done. Where'd I just leave the knife?

trigger.detail: second slice finished and the utensil carried off

expected_answer.text: In the sink. You carried it over, set it down in the basin, and turned straight back toward the counter.

turns.text: No, I mean — which drawer was that one from?

trigger.detail: user repairs their own previous question

expected_answer.text: The one by the counter, the same drawer you dug the second knife out of before you washed it.

turns.text: Okay, so what did I just take out and put straight back?

trigger.detail: gaze leaves the doorway and settles on the open drawer

expected_answer.text: A knife. You put it back, then took another and closed the drawer.
